summary: Sila Realty Trust (NYSE: SILA) filed an 8-K disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Sunshine Ultimate Parent LLC and Merger Sub. Under the terms, each share of Sila common stock will be converted into the right to receive $30.38 in cash per share, representing the per-share merger consideration. The company’s board unanimously approved the merger, which will result in Sila merging with and into Merger Sub, becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. The filing notes a restriction on dividends during the term, with certain exceptions including regular quarterly dividends up to $0.40 per share, and permits additional dividends to maintain REIT status with an offsetting reduction in merger consideration. The transaction is a going-private acquisition by Parent, with the merger consideration in cash, and the anticipated close is subject to customary conditions. Watch for shareholder vote timing and any potential competing bids.
